main: client: 400, 409, 422, 429 show the server sentence, trimmed of nothing else
chain: unready source -> 409 -> the maker reads "still being prepared"
chain: failed source -> 409 -> the maker reads "could not be prepared"
chain: probe throws -> 422 -> the maker reads "could not read that video"; the probe error text stays server-side
chain: a second export from the same member while one runs -> 429 -> the maker reads "one export at a time"
click: render answers 409 {error} -> that sentence is the toast; no result box; Export is enabled again
